issues.description: The Person model's first name field is named inconsistently across artifacts: the problem statement and the template use 'firstName' (with getters/setters getFirstName/setFirstName), whereas the solution's common Person class uses 'givenName' (getGivenName/setGivenName). This breaks the expected mapping: client code and server service code (e.g., PersonScene, PersonController, PersonService) call getFirstName/setFirstName but the solution model does not provide these methods, causing confusion and compilation errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person attribute names and accessor methods consistent across all artifacts. Either revert the solution's Person class to use 'firstName' with getFirstName/setFirstName (recommended to match the problem statement and template), or update all usages (client views/controllers and server service/resource) and the problem statement to consistently use 'givenName' everywhere.
